clues: This city is the capital of a province in western China. It is the biggest city on a vast high plateau.
Because it sits so high, the air stays cool here. Its weather sits on the edge of dry and cold zones.
For a long time this place was part of one province. In 1928 leaders added it to a new one.
For more than two thousand years, traders stopped here. They used the north Silk Road trade route.
Kumbum Monastery is a famed holy site here. Buddhists hold this place in high regard.
